title: Lucy Simpson:
title_short: Lucy Simpson · There Is No Shame in It
headline: NIWRC’s CEO says the one thing about Domestic Violence Awareness Month that most people never hear said plainly: there is no shame in it, it happens in every community, and the thing to do this month is find your local program.
story: Lucy Simpson is the Chief Executive Officer of NIWRC. At the end of her patio interview she gave a clean 40-second answer on Domestic Violence Awareness Month. It is one thought, start to finish, so this cut keeps her order and cuts nothing inside it. Her other cut, Safety Is Not the Absence of Violence (13294963154), uses none of these lines.

One voice, hers. Hopeful, never somber: the point is that the conversation gets easier when the shame goes, and that anyone can do something this month. No images of harm, no red handprint, no stock footage.

Loops: L1 “No shame in what?” opens at 0:00 and closes at 0:04 (“Domestic Violence Awareness Month is in October”). L2 “What can one person do about it?” opens at 0:00 and closes in the BUTTON (“go find out where is your local domestic violence program”). Stakes: conversations that never happen because of stigma and shame, in every community.
do: Open on Lucy mid-sentence with the hook text already on screen at 0:00.

Use the C2 file (Event 4) for picture and the times. Use the C1 file (Event 5) for sound. C1 runs about 1.5 s ahead of C2: C1 time = C2 time minus 1.5 s. Check by ear on “Domestic Violence Awareness Month”.
Name super at 0:04, lower left, 2 seconds: Lucy Simpson / Chief Executive Officer, NIWRC. Name and title only.
Match Qendrim’s approved NIWRC look: same lower third, caption style, color and pacing as the reference. Get his Premiere lower-third and caption template before V1.
Keep her whole answer in her order. Cut on breaths, not mid-word.
End on her face after “raise awareness about this issue”. Hold 1 s.
dont: No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
Do not use any line before C2 06:57. Her safety definition, hope, survivors and Native women leadership lines belong to NIWRCOKCLucySafetyIsNotAbsence001 (13294963154).
No victim imagery, no red handprint, no stock footage, no images of harm or fear.
No Tribal affiliation on the name super.
Do not use the C2 camera-mic sound. It is camera mic only.
